content.text:
Priya, you were charged twice, and here is exactly what happened.

Two payments of ₹999 each went through against the same order, ORD-2201:

  payment 123, settled at 10:15:02 on 19 August
  payment 124, settled at 10:15:05 on 19 August, three seconds later

Both succeeded, and each one carries its own idempotency key from the checkout, ending 9f21ab and c7d038. A retried payment would have reused a single key, so this was the checkout being submitted twice rather than one payment being retried. Your order was a single annual Pro renewal, so only one of those two ₹999 payments should ever have been taken.

I am not able to issue the refund myself. The correct outcome is for a colleague to refund payment 124 and leave payment 123 in place, and I can raise that for you now so nobody has to repeat this check.
